errors.account_locked: Account locked due to too many failed attempts. Try again later
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to perform this action
errors.pallet_not_configured: The selected variant does not have units per pallet configured. Contact the administrator to set it up.
errors.unit_materials_not_configured: This variant has no individual packaging materials configured. Contact the administrator to set them up before quoting.
errors.pallet_materials_not_configured: This variant has no pallet materials configured. Contact the administrator to set them up before quoting.
errors.raw_material_mix_required: This product is customizable: you must provide the raw material mix.
errors.presentation_missing_net_weight: This variant's presentation has no net weight configured. Contact the administrator to set it up.
errors.duplicate_raw_material_in_mix: Raw material {{rawMaterialId}} is duplicated in the mix.
errors.raw_material_not_in_pool: Raw material {{rawMaterialId}} is not allowed for this product.
errors.raw_material_percentage_out_of_range: Raw material {{rawMaterialId}} must be between {{minPercentage}}% and {{maxPercentage}}%.
errors.raw_material_not_mixable: Raw material {{rawMaterialId}} is not marked as mixable and cannot be used in a customizable product.
errors.raw_material_not_organic_compatible: Raw material {{rawMaterialId}} is neither an organic variant nor an "other" type item (water, salt, sugar...), so it cannot be used in a product marked as organic.
errors.raw_material_missing_cost_unit: Raw material {{rawMaterialId}} has no cost unit assigned. Contact the administrator to configure it before quoting.
errors.raw_material_cost_unit_type_mismatch: Raw material {{rawMaterialId}} has a cost unit that is not weight-based ({{unitType}}). It must be quoted in a weight unit (g, kg, lb) so its percentage of the presentation's net weight can be calculated.
errors.ingredient_missing_cost_unit: Ingredient {{ingredientId}} has no cost unit assigned. Contact the administrator to configure it before quoting.
errors.ingredient_cost_unit_type_mismatch: Ingredient {{ingredientId}} has a cost unit that is not weight-based ({{unitType}}). It must be costed in a weight unit so its grams can be scaled to the presentation's net weight.
errors.product_raw_material_percentage_required: You must provide a percentage for this raw material: this is a fixed-recipe product, the percentage cannot be left blank.
errors.product_raw_material_percentage_ceiling_: This fixed recipe's percentages would exceed 100% (would total {{projectedTotal}}%). Adjust this or another raw material before saving.
errors.fixed_recipe_percentage_must_total_100: This product has a misconfigured fixed recipe: its raw materials must total 100% (currently: {{percentageTotal}}%). Contact the administrator to fix it.
errors.invalid_unit_key: The selected unit does not exist in the catalog.
errors.intermediate_packaging_missing_units: This variant has an intermediate packaging configured but not the units that fit inside it. Contact the administrator to complete it before quoting.
errors.bulk_import_invalid_rows: The file has errors. Fix them and upload it again -- nothing was imported.
errors.bulk_import_empty_file: The file has no data rows to import.
errors.bulk_import_missing_columns: The file is missing these columns: {{columns}}.
errors.bulk_import_too_many_rows: The file has more than {{max}} rows. Split it into smaller files and import them separately.
errors.bulk_import_unknown_role: "{{value}}" is not a valid role. Use one of these values: {{validValues}}.
errors.bulk_import_duplicate_name_in_file: "{{displayName}}" already appears in row {{firstRow}} of this same file -- it's duplicated.
errors.bulk_import_duplicate_code_in_file: Code "{{code}}" already appears in row {{firstRow}} of this same file -- it's duplicated.
errors.raw_material_code_already_exists: A raw material with the code "{{code}}" already exists. The code must be unique.
errors.ingredient_code_already_exists: An ingredient with the code "{{code}}" already exists. The code must be unique.
errors.product_ingredient_grams_exceed_referenc: The ingredient's grams ({{grams}} g) can't be greater than the reference weight ({{referenceNetWeightGrams}} g) -- that would be more than 100% of the presentation's weight.
errors.packaging_code_already_exists: A packaging material with the code "{{code}}" already exists. The code must be unique.
errors.product_codigo_already_exists: A product with the code "{{codigo}}" already exists. The code must be unique.
errors.packaging_role_mismatch: Material {{packagingId}} is not of role "{{expectedRole}}" (it's "{{actualRole}}"). Choose a material of the correct role.
errors.product_variant_presentation_already_use: This product already has a variant for this Presentation. Each product can only have one SKU per Presentation.
errors.product_variant_presentation_immutable: You can't change the Presentation of an already-created SKU. Create a new SKU for the new Presentation.
errors.bulk_import_unknown_product_codigo: There is no active Product with the code "{{codigo}}". Create it first in the Products catalog.
errors.bulk_import_presentation_not_found: There is no active Presentation named "{{value}}". Create it first in the Presentations catalog.
errors.bulk_import_presentation_ambiguous: There is more than one active Presentation named "{{value}}" -- it's not possible to know which one to use. Fix the Presentations catalog first.
errors.bulk_import_unknown_packaging_code: There is no active packaging material with the code "{{code}}". Create it first in the Packaging catalog.
errors.bulk_import_sku_missing_unit_materials: The SKU for product "{{productCodigo}}" / presentation "{{presentationLabel}}" has no material row with role "unit packaging" -- at least one is required.
errors.bulk_import_sku_missing_pallet_materials: The SKU for product "{{productCodigo}}" / presentation "{{presentationLabel}}" has no material row with role "pallet material" -- at least one is required.
errors.bulk_import_duplicate_material_in_sku: Material "{{code}}" appears more than once for the SKU of product "{{productCodigo}}" / presentation "{{presentationLabel}}".
errors.bulk_import_intermediate_quantity_mismat: The intermediate packaging rows of the SKU for product "{{productCodigo}}" / presentation "{{presentationLabel}}" have different "Quantity" values -- it is a single value per SKU (units per intermediate package), so it must match across all rows of that role.
errors.bulk_import_multiple_defaults_in_group: The "{{group}}" group of the SKU for product "{{productCodigo}}" / presentation "{{presentationLabel}}" has more than one option marked as default -- mark only one per group.
errors.bulk_import_default_without_group: "Default" can only be marked on a row with a "Group" -- a material without a group is fixed and always quoted.
errors.bulk_import_option_group_too_long: The group name "{{value}}" exceeds the {{max}}-character limit.
errors.bulk_import_sku_inconsistent_fields: The SKU for product "{{productCodigo}}" / presentation "{{presentationLabel}}" has different values for Boxes per pallet/Bags per box across its rows -- they must be the same across every row of the same SKU.
errors.bulk_import_sku_presentation_already_use: Product "{{productCodigo}}" already has a SKU for Presentation "{{presentationLabel}}" -- each Product can only have one SKU per Presentation.
errors.bulk_import_sku_recipe_incomplete: Product "{{productCodigo}}" doesn't have a complete recipe, so its SKU for presentation "{{presentationLabel}}" can't be created. Load its recipe first (step 2): a fixed recipe must total 100% and a customizable one needs at least one raw material.
errors.bulk_import_missing_file: You must select a file to import.
errors.bulk_import_invalid_file_type: The file must be Excel (.xlsx or .xls).
errors.bulk_import_file_too_large: The file exceeds the maximum allowed size (5MB).
errors.bulk_import_upload_error: An error occurred while uploading the file. Please try again.
errors.bulk_import_unknown_raw_material_type: "{{value}}" is not a valid raw material type. Use one of these values: {{validValues}}.
errors.bulk_import_invalid_boolean: "{{value}}" is not a valid value. Use Yes or No.
errors.bulk_import_category_not_found: There is no active Category named "{{value}}".
errors.bulk_import_category_ambiguous: There is more than one active Category named "{{value}}" -- it's impossible to tell which one to use. Fix the Categories catalog first.
errors.bulk_import_subcategory_not_found: There is no active Subcategory named "{{value}}". Create it first in the Subcategories catalog.
errors.bulk_import_subcategory_not_found_in_cat: There is no active Subcategory named "{{value}}" in the Category "{{category}}".
errors.bulk_import_subcategory_ambiguous: There is more than one active Subcategory named "{{value}}" (in different Categories) -- fill in the "Categoría" column to say which one.
errors.bulk_import_client_not_found: There is no active Client named "{{value}}". Create it first in the Clients catalog.
errors.bulk_import_client_ambiguous: There is more than one active Client named "{{value}}" -- it's impossible to tell which one to use. Fix the Clients catalog first.
errors.bulk_import_recipe_type_required: "Tipo de receta" (recipe type) is required: enter Fija (fixed) or Personalizable (customizable).
errors.bulk_import_invalid_recipe_type: "{{value}}" is not a valid recipe type. Use Fija (fixed) or Personalizable (customizable).
errors.bulk_import_unknown_raw_material_code: There is no active raw material with the code "{{code}}". Create it first in the Raw Materials catalog.
errors.bulk_import_min_max_on_fixed_recipe: Product "{{productCodigo}}" has a fixed recipe: use only the "Porcentaje" (percentage) column and leave "% mínimo"/"% máximo" (min/max) empty.
errors.bulk_import_percentage_on_customizable_r: Product "{{productCodigo}}" has a customizable recipe: leave the "Porcentaje" (percentage) column empty (the salesperson builds the mix) and optionally use "% mínimo"/"% máximo" (min/max).
errors.bulk_import_min_greater_than_max: The minimum % ({{min}}) can't be greater than the maximum % ({{max}}).
errors.bulk_import_duplicate_raw_material_in_pr: Raw material "{{code}}" appears more than once in the recipe of product "{{productCodigo}}".
errors.bulk_import_fixed_recipe_total_invalid: The recipe of product "{{productCodigo}}" totals {{total}}% -- a fixed recipe must total exactly 100%.
errors.bulk_import_customizable_pool_cannot_rea: With the ranges in product "{{productCodigo}}"'s recipe, no mix can total 100% (sum of minimums: {{minTotal}}%, sum of maximums: {{maxTotal}}%). Adjust the ranges.
errors.bulk_import_product_recipe_already_exist: Product "{{productCodigo}}" already has a recipe. This importer only creates new recipes -- edit it from the product's screen.
errors.bulk_import_unknown_ingredient_code: There is no active ingredient with the code "{{code}}". Create it first in the Ingredients catalog.
errors.bulk_import_duplicate_ingredient_in_prod: Ingredient "{{code}}" appears more than once in product "{{productCodigo}}".
errors.bulk_import_product_ingredients_already_: Product "{{productCodigo}}" already has ingredients. This importer only creates new ones -- edit them from the product's screen.
errors.quote_pdf_missing_file: You must attach the quote PDF.
errors.quote_pdf_invalid_file_type: The attached file must be a PDF.
errors.invalid_unit_material_selection: The selected unit packaging material is not a valid option for this SKU.
errors.invalid_intermediate_material_selection: The selected intermediate packaging material is not a valid option for this SKU.
errors.invalid_pallet_material_selection: The selected pallet material is not a valid option for this SKU.
errors.unit_material_default_not_configured: The "{{group}}" unit packaging option group of this variant has no option marked as default. Contact the administrator to configure it before quoting.
errors.intermediate_material_default_not_config: The "{{group}}" intermediate packaging option group of this variant has no option marked as default. Contact the administrator to configure it before quoting.
errors.pallet_material_default_not_configured: The "{{group}}" pallet material option group of this variant has no option marked as default. Contact the administrator to configure it before quoting.
errors.duplicate_material_group_selection: You can only choose one option from the "{{group}}" group.
errors.unit_material_default_deletion_blocked: You can't delete this material: it's the default of the "{{group}}" group (unit packaging) and that group still has other active options. Mark another material in the group as default first.
errors.intermediate_material_default_deletion_b: You can't delete this material: it's the default of the "{{group}}" group (intermediate packaging) and that group still has other active options. Mark another material in the group as default first.
errors.material_default_required: This material is the default of the "{{group}}" group and that group still has other active options. You can't remove its default status, make it fixed, or move it to another group until you mark another material in the group as default.
errors.pallet_material_default_deletion_blocked: You can't delete this material: it's the default of the "{{group}}" group (pallet materials) and that group still has other active options. Mark another material in the group as default first.
